```{julia}
using Random, LinearAlgebra, Statistics, PrettyTables
```

```{julia}
Random.seed!(42)

n, p = 200, 6
X = randn(n, p)
ωₜ = [1.5, -2., 0., 0.7, 0., 1.]
y = X * ωₜ .+ 0.3 .* randn(n)
λ = 0.5
ω̂ = (X'X + λ * I) \ (X'y)

rmse(ŷ, y) = sqrt(mean((ŷ - y) .^ 2))
@show rmse(X * ω̂, y)

coef_table = hcat(ωₜ, ω̂, abs.(ω̂ .- ωₜ))

# -- color bins (relative to max error)
e_max = maximum(coef_table[:, 3]) + eps()   # necessary to avoid divide-by-zero issues when erros are 0
# r = error ./ e_max


# thresholds & corresponding "red intensity"
threshold = (0.2, 0.4, 0.6, 0.8, 1.01)
reds = (52, 88, 124, 160, 196)

# coef_table = hcat(ω_true, ω̂, abs.(ω̂ .- ω_true))
# println("columns: ω_true, ω̂, |error|")
# display(coef_table)

column_labels = ["ωₜ", "ω̂", "|ω̂ − ω|"]


hlrs = Tuple(
    Highlighter(
        (data, i, j) -> j == 3 &&
                            (data[i, 3] / e_max <= threshold[k]) &&
                            (k == 1 || data[i, 3] / e_max > threshold[k-1]),
        Crayon(foreground=reds[k])
    )
    for k in eachindex(threshold)
)

formats = (
    ft_printf("%.4f"),   # col 1
    ft_printf("%.4f"),   # col 2
    ft_printf("%.6f"),   # col 3
)

pretty_table(
    coef_table;
    header=column_labels,
    # formatters=(ft_round(4),),
    # formatters=(ft_printf("%.5f"),),
    formatters=formats,
    alignment=:r,                   # body right-aligned (due to negatives)
    header_alignment=:c,          # header centered
    highlighters=hlrs
)
```

```{julia}
Random.seed!(42)

n, p = 200, 6
X = randn(n, p)
ωₜ = [1.5, -2., 0., 0.7, 0., 1.]
y = X * ωₜ .+ 0.3 .* randn(n)
λ = 0.5
ω̂ = (X'X + λ * I) \ (X'y)

rmse(ŷ, y) = sqrt(mean((ŷ - y) .^ 2))
@show rmse(X * ω̂, y)

coef_table = hcat(ωₜ, ω̂, abs.(ω̂ .- ωₜ))
column_labels = ["ωₜ", "ω̂", "|ω̂ − ω|"]

# -- Rank-Based gradient
# 1. sort error column
# 2. compute its rank position
# 3. map rank -> red intensity
# r = error ./ e_max

errors = coef_table[:, 3]
nrows = length(errors)

# sort permutation yields rank ordering
perm = sortperm(errors)
ranks = similar(perm)
ranks[perm] .= 1:nrows              # assign ranks 1..n (smallest to largest)

# color intensity scale [aka lighter -> darker]
reds = range(52, 196, length=nrows)

hlrs = Tuple(
    Highlighter(
        (data, i, j) -> j == 3 && ranks[i] == k,
        Crayon(foreground=Int(round(reds[k])))
    )
    for k in 1:nrows
)

formats = (
    ft_printf("%.4f"),   # col 1
    ft_printf("%.4f"),   # col 2
    ft_printf("%.6f"),   # col 3
)

pretty_table(
    coef_table;
    header=column_labels,
    # formatters=(ft_round(4),),
    # formatters=(ft_printf("%.5f"),),
    formatters=formats,
    alignment=:r,                   # body right-aligned (due to negatives)
    header_alignment=:c,          # header centered
    highlighters=hlrs
)
```

```{julia}
Random.seed!(42)

n, p = 200, 6
X = randn(n, p)
ωₜ = [1.5, -2., 0., 0.7, 0., 1.]
y = X * ωₜ .+ 0.3 .* randn(n)
λ = 0.5
ω̂ = (X'X + λ * I) \ (X'y)

rmse(ŷ, y) = sqrt(mean((ŷ - y) .^ 2))
@show rmse(X * ω̂, y)

coef_table = hcat(ωₜ, ω̂, abs.(ω̂ .- ωₜ))
column_labels = ["ωₜ", "ω̂", "|ω̂ − ω|"]

# -- Rank-Based gradient
# 1. sort error column
# 2. compute its rank position
# 3. map rank -> red intensity
# r = error ./ e_max

errors = coef_table[:, 3]
nrows = length(errors)

# sort permutation yields rank ordering
perm = sortperm(errors)
ranks = similar(perm)
ranks[perm] .= 1:nrows              # assign ranks 1..n (smallest to largest)

# color intensity scale [aka lighter -> darker]
# reds = range(52, 196, length=nrows)
min_red, max_red = 52, 196

hlrs = Highlighter(
    (data, i, j) -> j == 3,
    (h, data, i, j) -> begin
        u = nrows == 1 ? 1.0 : (ranks[i] - 1) / (nrows - 1)   # u ∈ [0,1]
        red = round(Int, min_red + u * (max_red - min_red))
        Crayon(foreground=red)
    end
)

# formats = (
#     ft_printf("%.4f"),   # col 1
#     ft_printf("%.4f"),   # col 2
#     ft_printf("%.6f"),   # col 3
# )

pretty_table(
    coef_table;
    header=column_labels,
    formatters=(ft_printf("%.5f"),),
    alignment=:r,                   # body right-aligned (due to negatives)
    header_alignment=:c,          # header centered
    highlighters=(hlrs,),
)
```

```{julia}
Random.seed!(42)

n, p = 200, 6
X = randn(n, p)
ωₜ = [1.5, -2., 0., 0.7, 0., 1.]
y = X * ωₜ .+ 0.3 .* randn(n)
λ = 0.5
ω̂ = (X'X + λ * I) \ (X'y)

rmse(ŷ, y) = sqrt(mean((ŷ - y) .^ 2))
@show rmse(X * ω̂, y)

coef_table = hcat(ωₜ, ω̂, abs.(ω̂ .- ωₜ))
column_labels = ["ωₜ", "ω̂", "|ω̂ − ω|"]



perm = sortperm(coef_table[:, 3])
coef_table = coef_table[perm, :]

nrows = size(coef_table, 1)

# sort permutation yields rank ordering
ranks = similar(perm)
ranks[perm] .= 1:nrows              # assign ranks 1..n (smallest to largest)

min_red, max_red = 80, 255

hlrs = Highlighter(
    (data, i, j) -> j == 3,
    (h, data, i, j) -> begin
        u = nrows == 1 ? 1.0 : (ranks[i] - 1) / (nrows - 1)   # u ∈ [0,1]
        red = round(Int, min_red + u * (max_red - min_red))
        Crayon(foreground=(red, 0, 0))
    end
)

# formats = (
#     ft_printf("%.4f"),   # col 1
#     ft_printf("%.4f"),   # col 2
#     ft_printf("%.6f"),   # col 3
# )

pretty_table(
    coef_table;
    header=column_labels,
    formatters=(ft_printf("%.5f"),),
    alignment=:r,                   # body right-aligned (due to negatives)
    header_alignment=:c,          # header centered
    highlighters=(hlrs,),
)
```
